mapper.select:
SELECT , e.employee_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN hrm_employee e ON u.employee_id = e.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT , e.employee_name FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON u.id = ud.user_id AND ud.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hrm_employee e ON u.employee_id = e.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
SELECT r.role_name FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC
